primary_checks: OCHA OPT checked first; no Gaza-specific development published or surfaced within the observation window. The newest surfaced OCHA Gaza material remained outside the window.
WHO checked second; no Gaza-specific health, hospital-capacity, fuel, medical-access, or medical-evacuation development published or surfaced within the observation window.
degradation: BBC targeted retrieval was blocked by robots.txt; remaining official/humanitarian and established reporting coverage was sufficient to complete the watch.
exclusions: Associated Press material updated before the observation window concerned the same five-death Gaza City strike already captured by the prior watch and was excluded as a duplicate.
WAFA's Gaza casualty update at 14:04 Palestine time and Beit Lahia drone-strike item at 14:30 Palestine time were published before the observation window and excluded as pre-window material.
Older, recycled, opinion, unsupported social, duplicate, and unsourced material was excluded.
coverage_notes.conclusion: No distinct, traceable qualifying development was verified within the observation window.
